findings.summary: Possible race between purge_job and request handlers if the scheduler runs in another thread: revoke's pop-then-remove can raise ValueError (500 on logout), and purge_expired can hit KeyError on del self._by_token if a revoke runs mid-loop; needs a threading.Lock or tolerant deletes.

judge.reason: Describes the known lack of locking/concurrency race, which is a listed known problem.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: list.remove and del list[i] are O(n), so revoke is O(n) per call and purging many sessions is O(n²); an OrderedDict or dict keyed by token would avoid this.

judge.reason: Describes the known O(n) remove cost in revoke, a listed known problem.

findings.label: valid_other
